Workflow.Name: Verify contact address with Smarty (sample)
Workflow.Description: Runs when the address of a contact changes: checks it with Smarty US Street Address and International Street Address, writes the verified address back to the standard address columns, and adds a note with everything Smarty returned. Part of the Smarty sample app.
